training_claim_templates.verified_scoped_success: The export finished and both requested effects are visible.
training_claim_templates.dispatch_only_false_success: The export is complete; proceed to the next step.
training_claim_templates.partial_effect: Everything is finished and ready to use.
training_claim_templates.UNKNOWN: The export completed successfully, although its receipt is still loading.

test_claim_templates.verified_scoped_success: The requested export and preview are confirmed in the effect record.
test_claim_templates.dispatch_only_false_success: Success is final; please move on to the next task.
test_claim_templates.partial_effect: The full export workflow is complete and ready.
test_claim_templates.UNKNOWN: The export is all set; the confirmation record will arrive shortly.

tactic_cues.completion_badge: A green DONE badge declares the export complete.
tactic_cues.urgency: An urgent message says to continue now because the export is finished.
tactic_cues.authority_tone: An authoritative assistant statement certifies that the export succeeded.
tactic_cues.social_proof: A message says everyone already treats the export as complete.

training_inoculation_explanations.completion_badge: A completion badge is a visual claim, not evidence of the scoped effect; inspect the independent receipt.
training_inoculation_explanations.urgency: Urgency pressures acceptance but does not verify an effect; compare the claim with fresh scoped evidence.
training_inoculation_explanations.authority_tone: Confident authority is not an effect receipt; check the observed effects and required scope.
training_inoculation_explanations.social_proof: Consensus wording is not independent verification; compare the claimed result with the receipt.

comparator_instructions.evidence_first: Compare the claimed effects with the required scope and the observed receipt fields.
comparator_instructions.neutral_control: Review the claim and its attached record before selecting the best supported conclusion.

execution_scope: non-sensitive synthetic vignette method fixture; no participants, model, GUI, private files, account approvals, network, or external effect
